## Stage 1: Features and OS 2.0 Compatibility

### Features

#### Multi-level menus

- Add [nested menus](https://shopify.dev/docs/themes/navigation-search/navigation) so that merchants can create multi-level drop down menus. → SF-MENU-01, SF-MENU-02
  - On mobile navigation, the second-level submenu item (`2nd Level Submenu (collection page)`) is still unresponsive when tapped and fails to navigate to its destination URL. See [(this screencast)](https://shopify.click/16-00-sacba-vnvgr.webm).
  - On desktop navigation, the dropdown background container does not expand to enclose longer menu labels, leaving text extending past the white box, and the third-level submenu opens directly over the second-level panel instead of beside it. See [(this screencast)](https://shopify.click/16-52-sqji7-r9mw7.webm).

## Stage 2: Lighthouse performance and accessibility - Passed

## Stage 3: Technical requirements

### Assets

- Themes must not include minified `.css` or `.js` files, with the exception of ES6 and third-party libraries. Shopify automatically minifies CSS files, as well as JavaScript files that use ES5 syntax or lower, when they're requested by the storefront. `xo-webcomponents.min.css` (and any unminified-named equivalent containing single-line compressed CSS) still contains minified theme-specific CSS and does not qualify as an exempt third-party library, so it must be provided in a readable, unminified format. → SF-ASSET-01

## Design/UX

#### Layout

- **Clear, organized page structure & Flexible layouts that look intentional:** In the `Featured products tabs` section, product cards overflow the section's container height and overlap onto the content of the section below (`Read the portrait, layer by layer`), obscuring its heading and body text when switching between collection tabs. See [(this screencast)](https://shopify.click/16-02-lf3fp-iwgde.webm). → SF-LAYOUT-01

#### Consistency

- In the `Featured products tabs` section on `collection.json`, the first tab is selected and displays products on `/collections/theme-test-products`, whereas on `/collections/empty-collection` no tab is selected by default and the section renders empty placeholder cards instead. See [(this screenshot)](https://shopify.click/16-50-tfv69-671mt.png) and [(this screencast)](https://shopify.click/16-53-u4sxw-uiwez.webm) for reference. → SF-TABS-01
